commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak score of 36 and the Nifty 50 pinned in an institutional tug-of-war beneath overhead supply, Stan Weinstein's cardinal rule applies: never fight the market tape. Relentless FII net distribution exceeding ₹13,000 Cr reflects William O'Neil's classic market correction posture, where three out of four individual setups ultimately fail. Although select capital goods and niche manufacturing names are carving Stage 2 pivots on heavy accumulation, Mark Minervini's progressive exposure model dictates maximum defensive caution. AEROENTER.risk: Breaching 146.68 undermines the double-bottom base floor; enforce an immediate stop to guard trading principal against false breakout whip.

AEROFLEX.fundamental: Specialized metallic flexible flow and liquid cooling skid supplier. Q1 FY27 revenue rose 72% YoY to ₹145 Cr with PAT reaching ₹18.8 Cr. Boasts 18.9% ROCE, near-zero debt (0.02 D/E), and 65.5% promoter backing.
AEROFLEX.risk: A drop below 522.61 breaches the 20-session base and rising 21-EMA; execute rapid stop-loss discipline to minimize capital impairment.
